user.title: Set up TA CoE Sender
user.description: Target is the Technische Alternative C.M.I. The node number is the CAN address under which Home Assistant appears on the CAN bus; it must not be in use there. Leave the port empty to use the default of the chosen CoE version.

abort.already_configured: This C.M.I. is already configured with this node number.

add_mapping.title: Map a value
add_mapping.description: The value appears on the CAN bus as an output of this node. In the UVR create a CAN input with the same node and output number. Decimals: the value is multiplied by 10^decimals. For °C the default is 1 (45.3 °C is sent as 453). For all other units enter the number from the TA table of measured quantities.

settings.title: Send interval
settings.description: All values are sent immediately on every change and additionally at this interval. It must be shorter than the timeout of the CAN input in the UVR.

error.output_out_of_range: Output number too high for the chosen CoE version (V1: up to 32, V2: up to 64).
error.duplicate_output: This output is already in use.
error.unit_required: A unit is required for analog values.
error.decimals_required: There is no default for this unit. Please enter the decimals.
